spans.s: लंका f. 1. Name of the capital and habitation of Rāvaṇa; (it is identified with the chief town in Ceylon or with the whole island; in the opinion of some, Lankā was much larger than the present island of Ceylon), लंकेश्वरेणोषितमा प्रसादात् R.vi.40, xii.61, 63, 66, 84; 2. a branch; 3. a kind of grain; 4. a harlot, a prostitute.
लंका-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -नाथ, -पति m. lord of Lankā, i.e. Rāvaṇa.
लंका-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -नाथ, -पति m. lord of Lankā, i.e. Rāvaṇa.
लंका-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -नाथ, -पति m. lord of Lankā, i.e. Rāvaṇa.
लंका-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -नाथ, -पति m. lord of Lankā, i.e. Rāvaṇa.

लंका-अधिप, -अधिपति, -ईश, -ईश्वर, -नाथ, -पति m. lord of Lankā, i.e. Rāvaṇa.
लंका-अरि m. an epithet of Rāma.
लंका-दाहिन् m. an epithet of Hanūmat.
लंखनी f. The bit of a bridle.
लंग m. 1. A lover, a paramour; 2. union, association; 3. lameness.
लंगक m. A lover, a paramour.
लंगल n. A plough.
लांगल n. 1. A plough; 2. a plough-shaped beam; 3. the palm tree; 4. membrum virile; 5. a kind of flower.
लंगूल n. The tail of an animal.
लांगुल n. 1. A tail; 2. membrum virile.
लांगूल n. 1. A tail, लांगूलविक्षेपविसर्पिशोभैः K.S.i.13, लांगूलचालनमधश्चरणावपातम् Bhartr.ii.31; 2. membrum virile.

लंघ् (I) vt. or vi. 1U (pp. लंघित; pres. लंघति-ते; desid. लिलंघिषति-ते) 1. To abstain from food, to fast; 2. to go, to leap, to go by leaps; 3. to go beyond, to transgress; 4. to traverse, to mount upon, अन्ये चालंघिषुः शैलान् Bt.xv.32, R.iv.52, i.47; 5. to dry, to dry up.
लंघ् (II) vt. 10U (pres. लंघयति-ते) See Caus. below.

लंघ् Caus. (लंघयति-ते) 1. to leap over, to go beyond, न लंघयेद्वत्सतंत्रीम् M.iv.38; 2. to traverse, to mount, to ascend; 3. to violate, to disregard, to disrespect, to offend, to displease, हस्त इव भूतिमलिनो यथायथा लंघयति खलः सुजनम् Vas.D.; 4. to cause to fast; 5. to excel, to surpass, to outshine, जगत्प्रकाशं तदशेषमिज्यया भवद्गुरुर्लंघयितुं ममोद्यतः R.iii.48; 6. to shine; 7. to disobey, R.ix.9; 8. to avert, e.g. नियतिः केन लंघ्यते.With अभि-, 1. to go beyond; 2. to transgress, to disobey.With उद्-, 1. to go over, to cross over; 2. to mount.With वि-, 1. to traverse, विलंघिताध्वा R.v.42; 2. to go beyond proper limits, R.ix.74; 3. to violate, to neglect, गम्तुं प्रवृत्ते समयं विलंघ्य K.S.iii.25; 4. to surpass, to excel, कर्णोत्पलं प्रायस्त्व दृष्ट्या विलंघ्यते K.D.ii.224; 5. to give up, to abandon, मनो बबंधान्यरसान्विलंघ्य सा R.iii.4; 6. to cause to fast.

लंघन m. 1. The act of leaping; 2. stepping across, R.xvi.33; 3. ascending, mounting, attaining, जनोयमुच्चैःपदलंघनोत्सुकः K.S.v.64; 4. storming, capturing; 5. exceeding, going beyond, transgressing; 6. despising, disregarding; (as in प्रणिपातलंघन); 7. injury, harm (as in आतपलंघन); 8. fasting, abstinence; 9. a particular pace of a horse; 10. going by leaps, going quickly, यूयमेव पथि शीघ्रलंघनाः
Ghat.8
लंघित a. (f. ता) 1. Leaped over; 2. traversed; 3. transgressed, violated; 4. insulted, disregarded.
लंघित a. (f. ता) 1. Leaped over; 2. traversed; 3. transgressed, violated; 4. insulted, disregarded.
लंज m. 1. A foot; 2. a tail; 3. the end of a lower garment tucked behind.
लंजा f. 1. A current; 2. sleep; 3. an adulteress; 4. an epithet of Lakṣmī.
लंजिका f. A whore, a prostitute.
लंड n. Excrement.
लंड्र m. London (probably from the French Londres).
लंपट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. Covetous, greedy; 2. addicted to licentious pleasures, dissolute.
लंपट (II) m. A libertine.
लंपट (I) a. (f. टा) 1. Covetous, greedy; 2. addicted to licentious pleasures, dissolute.
लंपाक m. The same as लंपट q.v.
लंफ m. A leap, a jump.
लंफन n. Leaping, jumping.

लंब् vt. or vi. 1Ā (pres. लंबते) 1. To hang down, to hang from, to depend from, स्तनाभोगे पतन्भाति कपोलात्कुटिलोऽलकः । शशांकबिंबतो मेरौ लंबमान इवोरगाः R.G.; 2. to be attached to, to rest on; 3. to stretch out, करेण वातायनलंबितेन R.xiii.21; 4. to lag behind, to fall behind, Sis.ix.20; 5. to go down, to decline, to set; 6. to delay, प्रस्थानं ते कथमपि सखे लंबमानस्य भावि Megh.i.41; 7. to sound.With अव-, 1. to hang from, to descend; 2. to cling to, to support oneself by, ययौ तदियामवलंब्य चांगुलिम् R.iii.25, Sis.ix.39; 3. to depend upon; 4. to hold, हस्तेन तस्थाववलंब्य वासः R.vii.9; 5. to bear up against sorrow or calamity, हृदयं न त्ववलंबितुं क्षमाः R.viii.60; 6. to assume, to take, अभ्यर्थनाभंगभयेन साधुर्माध्यस्थ्यमिष्टेऽप्यवलंबतेऽर्थे K.S.i.52.With आ-, 1. to rest upon; 2. to hang from, to depend from; 3. to support, आधोरणालंबितमग्र्यवेशम् R.xviii.39; 4. to take refuge with, to depend on, आलंबे जगदालंबे हेरंबचरणंबुजे Mall.; 5. to take hold of, अथालंब्य धनू रामो जगर्ज गजविक्रमः Bt.vi.35; 6. to assume, to take.With उद्-, to stand erect, पादेनैलेन गगने द्वितीयेन च भूतले तिष्ठाम्युल्लंबितः Mrich.ii.With वि-, 1. to hang from, R.x.62; 2. to decline, to set; 3. to stay, to remain, K.S.vii.13; 4. to delay, विलंबितफलैः कालं स निनाय मनोरथैः R.i.33.
लंब (I) a. (f. बा) 1. Hanging down, depending, मुखमसकलव्यक्ति लंबालकत्वात् Megh.ii.21; 2. attached; 3. spacious, great, large; 4. long, tall.
लंब (II) m. 1. A perpendicular; 2. the arc between the pole of any place and the zenith.
लंब (I) a. (f. बा) 1. Hanging down, depending, मुखमसकलव्यक्ति लंबालकत्वात् Megh.ii.21; 2. attached; 3. spacious, great, large; 4. long, tall.
लंबा f. 1. An epithet of Durgā; 2. of Lakṣmī.
लंब-उदर m. 1. an epithet of Gaṇeśa; 2. a glutton.
लंबोष्ठ m. a camel.
लंबोष्ठ m. a camel.
लंब-कर्ण m. 1. an ass; 2. a goat; 3. an elephant; 4. a falcon; 5. a demon.
लंब-जठर a. big-bellied.
लंब-स्फिच् a. having protuberant buttocks.
लंबक m. 1. A perpendicular (in geometry); 2. the complement of latitude (in astromomy).
लंबन (I) m. 1. An epithet of Śiva; 2. the phlegmatic humour.
लंबन (II) n. 1. Hanging down; 2. the parallax in longitude (of the moon); 3. a sort of necklace.
लंबिका f. The soft palate.
लंबित a. (f. ता) 1. Hanging down; 2. sunk, gone down; 3. resting on, (pp. of लंब् q.v.).
लंबित a. (f. ता) 1. Hanging down; 2. sunk, gone down; 3. resting on, (pp. of लंब् q.v.).
लंबुषा f. A necklace of seven strings.
लंभ m. 1. Attainment, acquirement; 2. gain; 3. recovery.
लंभन n. 1. Attainment, acquirement; 2. recovery.
लंभित a. (f. ता) 1. Procured, gained, obtained; 2. employed, applied; 3. cherished; 4. addressed.
लंभित a. (f. ता) 1. Procured, gained, obtained; 2. employed, applied; 3. cherished; 4. addressed.
लांगलीषा f. the pole of a plough.
लांगल-ग्रह m. a ploughman, a peasant.
लांगल-दंड m. the pole of a plough.
लांगल-ध्वज m. a name of Balarāma.
लांगल-पद्धति f. a furrow.
लांगल-फाल m.n. a ploughshare.
लांगलिन् m. 1. An epithet of Balarāma, बंधुप्रीत्या समरविमुखो लांगली याः सिषेवे Megh.i.49; 2. the cocoanut tree; 3. a snake.
लांगली f. The cocoanut tree.
लांगूलिन् m. A monkey, an ape.
लांछ् vt. 1P (pres. लांछति) 1. To distinguish, to mark; 2. to decorate.

लांछन n. 1. A sign, a token, a mark, नवांबुदानांकमुहूर्तलांछने धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त सायकम् R.iii.53; 2. a name, an appellation; 3. a stain, a mark of ignominy; 4. a land-mark; 5. the spots on the disc of the moon, K.S.vii.36.
लांछित a. (f. ता) 1. Marked, distinguished; 2. named; 3. furnished with; 4. decorated.
लांछित a. (f. ता) 1. Marked, distinguished; 2. named; 3. furnished with; 4. decorated.
लांठनी f. An unchaste woman.
लांपट्य n. Lewdness, lasciviousness.
